title: Past Perfect / Ilaa ka dambeeyey (horayska horay)
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, ilaaka dambeeyey (ay isku dayay) u sheegtaa shuqulka ugu horreysay shuqul kale ugu horreysay. Af-Ingiriisiga, past perfect (had eaten) waxay leedahay la haqantimaad ayoola, laakiin waxaa jira farqood mishaari: midaafka ereyada waa kala duwan (af-Ingiriisiga mar walba 'had + participle'), oo af-Ingiriisiga ayaa badan istaagtaa 'already', 'just', 'never' si ay u soo baxaan tarta. Fiir: af-Soomaaliga mararka qaarkood waxaan isticmaalnaa pretérito indefinido (isku dayay) meesha af-Ingiriiska u baahanayo past perfect (had eaten) markii ay jirto shuqul horreysan cad. Hadana, af-Soomaaliga ilaaka dambeeyey waxay soo saacda verbiga 'haber' la conjugated, inta af-Ingiriiska 'had' waa aan la soo jeedin karo dadka oo dhan.
rule: Past perfect waxay soo saacda 'had' (dadka oo dhan) + participle-ka verbiga ugu weyn. Waxay isticmaalataa inay u sheegaan shuqul ay sameeyey ilaa shuqul kale ugu horreysay, yaa u ah 'horayska horay'. Jumalada aqoonsiga: isaga + had + participle. Jumalada diida: had not (hadn't) + participle. Su'aalooyinka: Had + isaga + participle. Waxay isticmaalataa calaamooyin wakhti oo 'already', 'just', 'never', 'ever', 'by the time', 'before', 'after'. Miyar: 'I had finished my homework before dinner' (ay isku dayay shaqadaada ilaa dinner). Waxay isticmaalataa hadana hadladda aan xad gudbin inay soo noqdeen wakhti (present perfect -> past perfect). Khilaaf: af-Ingiriiska 'after' iyo 'before' mararka qaarkood waxay isticmaalayaa horayska iftiinka haddii midaafka yahay cad, laakiin past perfect waxay bixiyaa faahfaahin.

title: Conditionals Type 1 and 2 / Shartiyada nooca 1 iyo 2
bridge: Faransiis, aannu u isticmaamo waaqadka xaliyadda subjunctiva qaybta sharti iyo xaliyadda conditional qaybta ugu weyn (Si tengo tiempo, iría). Ingiriisi, qalabka waa kala duwan: sharti kowaad aannu u isticmaamo waaqadka iftiinka ee qaybta 'if' iyo mustaqbalka 'will' qaybta ugu weyn. Sharti labaad, aannu u isticmaamo waaqadka iftiinka ee qaybta 'if' iyo 'would' + infinitive qaybta ugu weyn. Fiir: Ingiriisi, waaqadka iftiinka ee sharti labaad ma u sheegin wakhti dambe, laakiin qalad weyn ama aan weyn ahayn ee wakhti dambe ama mustaqbal. Ha ka qalad fiidiyowga faransiiska, maxaa yeelay, qalabka waxay kala duwaan.
rule: Sharti kowaad (nooca 1) wuxuu u isticmaalayaa qalado weyn ama wax la saabsan ee wakhti dambe ama mustaqbal. Waxay qudhacdaa: If + isku + fiilka ee waaqadka iftiinka, + isku + will + fiilka ee asalka. Misal: If it rains, we will stay at home. Qaybta 'if' waxay noqon kartaa ilaa hore ama ilaa dhinac, oo markii ay ilaa hore noqoto ayay kala soo baxaan koma. 'Unless' (si aynu u qalinayno) waxay u isticmaali kartaa 'if not'. Sharti labaad (nooca 2) wuxuu u isticmaalayaa qalado weyn, aan weyn ahayn ama aan weyn ahayn ee wakhti dambe ama mustaqbal. Waxay qudhacdaa: If + isku + fiilka ee waaqadka iftiinka, + isku + would + fiilka ee asalka. Misal: If I had more money, I would travel. Sharti labaad, fiilka 'to be' wuxuu u isticmaalayaa 'were' oo dhan (If I were...). 'Was' ma isticmaali karo qalab weyn, haddii ay ingiriiska aan weyn ahayn ayay isticmaali karo. 'Could' ama 'might' waxay u isticmaali kartaa 'would' si ay u sheegi kartaa awood ama awood.

title: Passive Voice: Present & Past / Codka jira: halkad iyo dhibic
bridge: Faransiiska, codka jira la sameeyaa 'ser' + shirka, sida Ingiriiska (to be + past participle). Laakiin, Ingiriiska, qaybta shakhsiga jira la soo dejisaa 'by', oo Faransiiska waxaynu isticmaalaa 'por'. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Ingiriiska, shakhsiga codka jira wuxuu u fududaa inuu sii fiican u fududeeyo Faransiiska, oo aan u adag codka jira ama codka jira ee ku soo jeeda ('se') ayay u jeclaan tahay. Khalad caadi ah waa in la fogeeyo fiilka 'to be' ama in la qaladiyo shakhliga shirka ee dhibic.
rule: Codka jira la sameeyaa fiilka 'to be' wakhtiga u adag (halkad cusub: am/is/are; dhibic cusub: was/were) + shirka fiilka ugu weyn. Shakhsiga hadalka jira wuxuu noqdaa qaybta shakhsiga jira 'by' (haddii aan la doonino inaan u muhiimno waxayno ka saari kartaa). Inaad sameeyso jira, shayga jira wuxuu noqdaa shakhsiga. Miskuwada: Jira: 'The chef cooks the meal' → Jira: 'The meal is cooked by the chef'. Halka, waxaynu isticmaalaa 'is/are' iyada oo ahaane shakhsiga (singular/plural). Dhibic, 'was/were'. Shirka dhibic waa shakhliga saddexaad ee fiilka (xaqiiq: -ed; aan xaqiiqsanayn: liiska). Xaaladda aan isticmaali jirto codka jira fiilka aan la qaadi karin (ma ay heli shay). Isticmaalka caadi ah: markii shakhsiga aan la garanayn, aan la qalad qalin, ama aan u yar yahay fiilka.

title: Reported Speech / Qiyaastii la soo sheegay ee asas
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, marka aad u baxdo qiyaastii la soo sheegay, waxaan beddelaynaa awoodda qiyaasta (sida 'wuxuu yidhi inuu jifyay'), oo Ingiriishuna waxyaabaha la mid ah waxay noqotaa laakiin waxyaalo kaladu beddelaysaa: adag-adagga, qiyaastii wakhtiga iyo meeshka (maanta→maalintaas, halkan→ halkaas) iyo nidaamka erayada. Khalad aad u xanuunsan yahay inaad qiyaastii dhexdhexaadka u hadashiso (wuxuu yidhi: 'I am tired' → *She said she is tired), laakiin Ingiriishi B1 waxaa la sugayaa 'backshift': 'She said she was tired'. Kala duwanaansan kalena waa in Ingiriishi ma isticmaali jirin 'that' (waxaad idhi kartaa 'She said she was tired' ama 'She said that she was tired'), halqad Soomaaliga 'in' waa la qalad.
rule: Qiyaastii la soo sheegay waxaa la isticmaalaa inaad sheegtid waxa qof kula yiri. Ingiriishi, qiyaastii u dhaqmaynta waxaa la adeegaa 'say' ama 'tell'. 'Say' ma qaadi karo shakhsi (Wuxuu yidhi inuu faraxsan yahay), halqad 'tell' waa in la qaado shakhsi (Wuxuu ii sheegay inuu faraxsan yahay). Beddelada ugu muhiimsan: 1) Qiyaastii (hadana→dhexdhexaad, dhexdhexaad→ku dhowaad): 'I am' → 'she was', 'I went' → 'she had gone'. 2) Adag-adagga: 'I' → 'he/she', 'my' → 'his/her'. 3) Qiyaastii wakhtiga: 'maanta'→'maalintaas', 'berri'→'maalinta dambe', 'malaxi'→'maalinta hore'. 4) Meesha: 'halkan'→'halkaas'. Xaaladdo: haddii shuqulka weli ha ahaade ama wakhtiga ma dhamayn, waxaad u hadasha kartaa qiyaastii dhexdhexaadka (Waxay tidhi ay jifyaysay - haddii ay weli jifyaysay). Waxaad isticmaali kartaa 'if' ama 'whether' si/maya, oo erayada weydiista oo ahaan cusubba, nidaamka aqoonsiga (Wuxuu i weydiiyay meesha aan nool yahay, 'where did I live' ma aha). Waxaad isticmaali kartaa 'tell/ask + shakhs + to + infinitive' (Wuxuu ii yiri inaan fadhiistee).

title: Gerunds and Infinitives as Subject and Object / Gerundiyo iyo infinitifka su’aalka iyo objeectka
bridge: Faransiis, aannu u isticmaamo infinitifka si ay u ahaadaan su’aalka iyo verb-walba ka dambeeyey (sida ‘nadar es divertido’, ‘me gusta nadar’). Ingiriisi, xaaladdii wuxuu ka buuxsamaa: mararka qaarkood aannu isticmaamo gerund (-ing) iyo mararka qaarkood aannu isticmaamo infinitif (to + fiil). Xaqiiqda guud ahu waxay tahay markii shuqulka ay su’aalka jirto ama objeectka oo fiil kale oo ‘enjoy’ ama ‘finish’ ayay noogu isticmaan gerund. Fiil kale oo ‘want’ ama ‘decide’ ayay noogu isticmaan infinitif. Tani waxay noqotaa isbeddel weyn oo ku saabsan af-Soomaaliga ee aan u baahnayn iska yiraqdir.
rule: Ingiriisi, labo nooc oo aan shaqsayn ayay leedahay fiil: gerund (fiil + -ing) iyo infinitif (to + nooca asasiga). Su’aalka, gerund-ka waa nooca ugu caan ah oo dhab (sida ‘Swimming is healthy’). Objeectka, doortay wuxuu ku xiran yahay fiilka ugu weyn: qaarkood oo fiil ayay la socdaan gerund (enjoy, finish, avoid, suggest, consider), qaarkood oo fiil ayay la socdaan infinitif (want, need, decide, hope, plan). Qaarkood oo fiil ayay beddelaan maana ahayd nooc ayay isticmaan (sida ‘stop’ ama ‘remember’). Macmiilka B1, waxay u faydaan in ay ku dhaqaan liiska fiilka caadi ah iyo in ay dhammaystaan tusaale.

title: Modal Verbs for Deduction / Fariin la tixraac (must, might, could)
bridge: Af-Soomaali, aannu u isticmaalo 'waadno' si aanu u tixraacno waxyaabaha aan u fiican u yaqaan, 'waa la yaabaa' inuu yahay imisa mid, iyo 'waa la yaabaa' inuu yahay wax aan u fiican u yaqaan. Mararka qaarkood, Ingiriisi ku jira farq ogyahay: fariinta modal ayaa la isticmaalaa oo aan la qorino 'to'. Waxyaalaha kale oo muhiim ah waa in Af-Soomaali aannu ka badan u isticmaalo dushooda ('ayno') si aanu u tixraacno, laakiin Ingiriisi aannu isticmaalo 'must' + fiilka asaasiga. Waxa laguu dhali karo khalad haddii aad u turjumo si adag. Xusuuso: Ingiriisi, tixraaca waxay u qoran tahay fariin + fiilka asaasiga, oo aan la qorino 'to', oo mitaanka jumbada waa shax + fariin + fiil.
rule:
Ingiriisi, si aanu u tixraacno waxyaalaha ee mudan waa ina isticmaalo 'must', 'might' iyo 'could'.
- **Must** + fiilka asaasiga: waxay u muujisaa tixraac oo aan u fiican u yaqaan (xukun, dalil adag). Waxay u eg yahay 'waadno' Af-Soomaali. Misal: 'She must be at home' (Waxay noqonaysaa inay guriga ku jirto).
- **Might** + fiilka asaasiga: waxay u muujisaa imisa mid, qalad. Waxay u eg yahay 'waa la yaabaa' ama 'waa la yaabaa'. Misal: 'He might be sick' (Waa la yaabaa inuu sick ahay).
- **Could** + fiilka asaasiga: waxay u muujisaa imisa, laakiin mararka qaarkood waxay u isticmaalataa si loo soo diriso in waxaa la yaabaa, laakiin aan u fiican u yaqaan. Waxay u eg yahay 'waa la yaabaa'. Misal: 'It could rain today' (Waa la yaabaa inay malin rain).

**Fariimaha:** fariimaha modal ayaa aan la beddelo shakhsi (aan la qorino '-s' la 'he/she/it'). Aan la qorino 'to' ka dibna. Difaafta 'must' ee tixraaca waa 'can't' (aan 'mustn't'): 'She can't be at work' (Ma ay noqon karo inay shaqada ku jirto).

**Isticmaalka:** waxay u isticmaalataan in la hadlo tixraacada xukunta ee mudan. Tixraacada ee dhexdhexaadba, waxaa la isticmaalaa 'must have + participio', 'might have + participio', oo ka badan, laakiin waxa uu ka badan yahay B1.

**Khilaafadaha:** 'must' ma isticmaalino su'aasha tixraaca; 'Do you think...' ama xogta weydiistka ee 'be' ama fiil kale.

title: Relative Clauses: Defining vs. Non-Defining / Xukumooyin natiijiyeya: Xusuusaan iyo Fayafaan
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, xusuusaan iyo fayafaan ku xusan tahay xusuusaan la qorsheeyey koma. Ingiriisi, koma iyo isku dhigo pronoune ku beddelan: 'that' waxay u adeegsan yahay xusuusaan (oo lagu qalbi gali karo), 'which/who' waxay u adeegsan yahay fayafaan oo koma la qorsheeyey. Fiirso: Ingiriisi ma aad u isticmaal karo 'that' fayafaan.
rule: Xusuusaan (waxay xusuusan yihiin niman ama wax alla wixii aan ku hadalno) koma ayay u qorsheeyn karaysaa iyo isticmaal 'that' ama 'who/which'. Qoraalka aan rasmi ahayn, 'that' (ama isku dhigida pronoune) lagu qalbi gali karo: 'The book (that) I bought'. Fayafaan (waxay ku daran macluumaad badan oo aan u eg yaraade) koma ayay u qorsheeyn karaysaa iyo isticmaal 'who' dadka iyo 'which' waxyaabaha, 'that' ma isticmaalina. Pronoune fayafaan ma lagu qalbi gali karo. Tusaale: Xusuusaan: 'The woman who lives next door is a doctor.' (Haweenka joogta jirta jirta waxay noqotay da’i). Fayafaan: 'My sister, who lives in Madrid, is a doctor.' (Walaashay, joogta Madrid, waxay noqotay da’i).

title: Wish + past / Wish to express unreal desires
bridge: Farceeji ah, aannu naga 'in sha Allah' ama 'waxaan jeclaan lahaa in' la subjunktivi inay u soo galin xagga doonaynta aan haqicanayn. Ingiriisi, 'wish' wuxuu la socdaa waqtiga dhexdeeda (ama waqtiga dhexdeeda) inuu soo galin in qiyaastii aan haqicanayn ee hadda ama aan ay qaban karin horay. Khalad aan la adeegsanayo waxaa loo isticmaalaa hadda ama shartiga ('I wish I have...' ama 'I wish I would have...'), oo loo soo baxay farceeji. Xusuuso: dhexdeeda Ingiriisi halkan ma u sheegin waqtiga, laakiin aan haqicanayn.
rule: Qorihii ugu horraysa waxaa la mid ah: **wish + isku + fiilka waqtiga dhexdeeda** doonaynta ee hadda (qiyaastii aan haqicanayn ama xaalad aan la qiyaasi karo). Misaal: 'I wish I knew the answer' (Anigu ma ayay). Inaad u soo galin doonaysid horay (wax aan dhacay), aad isticmaashid **wish + waqtiga dhexdeeda** ('I wish I had studied more'). 'Would' ma isticmaalina 'wish' markii isku wuxuu la mid yahay (I wish I would... waa khalad); 'would' la isticmaalaa kalood u gudubta ama doonaynta ee isku xumaan (I wish you would stop). 'Wish' + 'were' waa mid ka mid ah 'was' (haddii 'was' loo isticmaalo Ingiriisi aan xad gudubtaynin). Xusuuso in 'wish' u soo galin xumaan ama adag; doonaynta ee aad u fiican u isticmaala 'hope' (I hope you come).

title: Used to / Sheekadka sheeko qarsoon
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, waxaan ku fiicnay 'ayay qaatay + fiilka' ama fiilka mid ka mid ah ee 'ayay qaatay' ('ayay qaatay') si ay u sheekaan sheeko qarsoon. Ingiriisi, 'used to' waa qoran oo kalena oo keliya qiyaastay qarsoon iyo aan la soo jeedin lahaa shakhsi (I used to, she used to). Khilaaf badan oo khilaaf badan oo ah in la xanuuniyo 'used to' la 'be used to' (in la aqoonsado) ama 'use to' in ay noqoto da'weeyo iyo su'aalo. Xusuuso in si aan la qirin lahaa iyo su'aal 'did not use to' iyo 'Did you use to?'.
rule: Used to waxay tusaale yihiin sheeko qarsoon ama xaalad qarsoon oo aan qiyaastaynin hal qaar. Qorihii wuxuu yahay: shaxs + ayay qaatay + fiilka. Ma jiro hal qaar ama qiyaastay; qiyaastay waxaan isticmaalnay 'usually' + fiilka mid ka mid ah. Si aan la qirin lahaa: ma ayay qaatayn + fiilka. Su'aalo: Did + shaxs + ayay qaatay + fiilka? (ilaa -d). Fiir: ma ayay qaatayn 'I use to' in ay qiyaastay, iyo 'used to' ma ay qaadan -ed qiyaastay maxaa yeelay ayay qiyaastay.

title: Purpose, Cause and Result / Qaalada, Sababta iyo Natiijada
bridge: Faransiiska, aan ku adeegaynaa 'para que' qaalada iyo 'porque' sababta, ingiriiska ku isticmaala 'so that' iyo 'because (of)'. Farqii weyn waa 'so that' mar walba ku raaci doonaa xukun (isimad + fiil), 'because of' mar walba ku raaci doonaa magaca. Si aan u adag, ingiriishi ku isticmaal 'so' (ilaa 'that') in lagu soo dirro natiijada, faransiiska 'así que' ama 'por lo tanto'.
rule:
Ingiriishi, qaalada, sababta iyo natiijada soo dirridda, xukummadaas ku isticmaal:
- **Qaalada:** 'so that' (para que) + xukun fiil ka mid ah (can, could, will, would) ama fiilka aasaasiga. Misal: 'I study so that I can pass the exam.' 'In order to' (para) + infinitive, la isticmaal si rasmi ah.
- **Sababta:** 'because' (porque) + xukun, ama 'because of' (debido a) + magaca ama jirka. Misal: 'She stayed home because she was sick' (xukun) vs. 'She stayed home because of the rain' (magaca).
- **Natiijada:** 'so' (así que) + xukun natiijada. Misal: 'It was raining, so we stayed home.' 'Therefore' (por lo tanto) si rasmi ah.
- **Farqii faransiiska:** Faransiiska, 'para que' ku baahan yahay subjunctive ('para que estudies'), ingiriishi ku isticmaal indicative (kuwa 'can' ama 'could'). Ha u xanuunsin 'so' (natiijada) 'so that' (qaalada).

title: Common Phrasal Verbs / Farriga Phrasal oo Ku filan yihiin
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, badan oo fiidmo ah ayaa u sheegaya fiil qoralo la'aan (sidoo kale 'saar', 'dhejiyo'), laakiin Af-Ingiriisi, farriga phrasal ayaa u soo bandhigaya fiil iyo qaybo (up, down, off, etc.) oo u beddela ama u xasasiyaa maanaheeda. Misaal, 'get up' ma aha 'hel inaad ka soo baxdo', laakiin 'ka soo bax'. Khilaafkii ugu weyn tahay in qaybahaas lama tarjumi karo si adag, iyo in farriga phrasal oo la qaybiyoon karo, shayga (magaca shayga ama magaca shayga) wuxuu u dhigayaa fiil iyo qaybo ('turn the TV off' ama 'turn off the TV'), waxa aan la isku leh Af-Soomaali.
rule: Fariin phrasal wuxuu yahay u soo bandhig fiil iyo qaybo ama adoomare (qaybo). Maanaheeda u soo bandhigga badan oo aan la qaadi karo qaybaha kala duwan. Sidaa darteed, waa in la aqoonsado sida wahada ah oo ah abuurka erey. Labada nooc ugu weyn waa: kuwo transitif iyo kuwo intransitif. Kuwa transitif ayaa noqon karo in la qaybiyoon karo ama aan la qaybiyoon karo. Kuwa la qaybiyoon karo, shayga (magaca shayga ama magaca shayga) wuxuu u dhigayaa fiil iyo qaybo, laakiin haddii shayga magaca shayga ah (it, them, etc.), waa in la qaybiyoon karo fiil iyo qaybo: 'turn it off' (maa 'turn off it'). Kuwa aan la qaybiyoon karo, shayga wuxuu u dhigayaa dambe qaybo: 'look after the children' (maa 'look children after'). Qaar ka mid ah farriga phrasal ayaa noqon karo in la qaybiyoon karo iyo aan la qaybiyoon karo: 'wake up', 'grow up'. Waa muhiim in la xusuusto meeshii u fiican iyo maanaheeda si taxaddar.

title: Advanced Quantifiers / Miisaaniyada Sare
bridge: Farriisin, aannu u isticmaalo 'badhan', 'badhan yahay', 'ma jiro casi' inaanu u sheego miisaan, laakiin Ingiriisi, waxaan u dhaqmay inaan u isticmaalo miisaaniyada badan oo leh xoumood calanimo iyo isticmaalka miisaan/aan la doonaynin. Khilaafkii ugu weyn waa 'hardly any' iyo 'plenty of' ma lahaan mid ka mid ah: 'hardly any' wuxuu u dhexeeyaa 'casi' iyo 'ma jiro', 'plenty of' wuxuu sheegayaa 'ka badan oo ka fiican', 'badhan'. Haddaba, xusuuso in 'plenty of' lagu isticmaalo kala duwan, ma aha bishaare ama su'aalo, wax ka beddel 'much/many'.
rule: Miisaaniyada sare ee Ingiriisi (B1) waxay ku jiraan: 'hardly any' (ma jiro casi/ma jiro) lagu isticmaalo dhaqan plural oo la doonayo iyo aan la doonaynin, waxayna leh maana xun (waxay u dhexeeya 'very few' ama 'very little'). 'Plenty of' (badhan, ka badan oo ka fiican) lagu isticmaalo jumalka kala duwan oo dhaqan plural oo la doonayo iyo aan la doonaynin (ma lagu isticmaalo su'aalo 'any' ama bishaare). Miisaaniyada kale: 'a good deal of' (badhan, rasmi, aan la doonaynin), 'a large amount of' (miisaan weyn, aan la doonaynin), 'a large number of' (tirada weyn, oo la doonayo), 'a couple of' (laba, oo la doonayo). Fiirso: 'plenty of' wuxuu raacayaa dhaqan ama adag, ma aha xaalad. 'Hardly any' wuxuu soo jeeda hortiisa dhaqan, waxaana laga amaajiyaa 'there is/are'. Su'aalo iyo bishaare, waxaa u fiican 'much' ama 'many' kala badala 'plenty'.

common_error.wrong: There are plenty of people in the party.
common_error.correct: There are plenty of people at the party.

common_error.explanation: Khalaafka waa isticmaalka preposition 'in' kala badala 'at' markaan u sheegnay hadal u dhaqmay. Haddana, ardayada baadhiya waxay isticmaashaan 'plenty of' su'aalo ama bishaare (e.g. 'Do you have plenty of money?'), laakiin halakanu waxaa u fiican in la isticmaalo 'much' ama 'many' (Do you have much money?). Xusuuso: 'plenty of' wuxuu muhiim ugu yahay kala duwan, iyo bishaare ama su'aalo waxaa lagu isticmaalo 'much' oo aan la doonaynin iyo 'many' oo la doonayo.

examples.original: There were hardly any students in class today.

levels.label: Plenty of

examples.original: Don't worry, we have plenty of food for everyone.

examples.original: There are plenty of books on that shelf.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑːr ˈplɛnti əv bʊks ɒn ðæt ʃɛlf/
examples.translation: Waxaa jira buug badan oo ka mid ah rafkaas.
examples.note: Dhaqanka plural oo la doonayo, 'plenty of' waa mid aad u isticmaal; Farriisin waxaan u tarjuman karnaa 'badhan', laakiin xoumada waa kuwa badan.

examples.original: We had plenty of opportunities to practice.
examples.phonetic: /wi hæd ˈplɛnti əv ˌɒpərˈtjuːnɪtiz tə ˈpræktɪs/

examples.note: Waxaa tarjumayaa 'ka badan oo ka fiican' in lagu soo baxdo xoumada badan. 'Plenty of' ma lagu isticmaalo su'aalo ama bishaare.

levels.label: Large quantities: a large number of / a large amount of
levels.translation: Miisaan weyn: tirada weyn / miisaan weyn

examples.original: A large number of tourists visit this city every year.
examples.phonetic: /ə lɑːrdʒ ˈnʌmbər əv ˈtʊərɪsts ˈvɪzɪt ðɪs ˈsɪti ˈɛvri jɪər/
examples.translation: Turist badan ayaa ku soo dhowaada magaalada si sanad-sanad.
examples.note: Lagu isticmaalo 'a large number of' dhaqan plural oo la doonayo (tourists).

examples.original: The factory produces a large amount of waste.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈfæktəri prəˈdjuːsɪz ə lɑːrdʒ əˈmaʊnt əv weɪst/
examples.translation: Factorka waxay bixiyaa miisaan weyn oo kharaash.
examples.note: Dhaqanka aan la doonaynin (waste), 'a large amount of' baa lagu isticmaalo.

examples.original: She spends a good deal of time on her homework.
examples.phonetic: /ʃi spɛndz ə gʊd diːl əv taɪm ɒn hɜːr ˈhoʊmwɜːrk/
examples.translation: Waxay qaadan wakhti badan inay shaqada u dhammaystaan.
examples.note: 'A good deal of' waa rasmi badan waxaana lagu isticmaalo dhaqanka aan la doonaynin (time). Waxay u dhexeeya 'a lot of' laakiin ma aha isku-daya.

title: Verb patterns: verb + infinitive / gerund / Xaaladdo farriimaha: fiil + infinitive / gerund
bridge: Farriisii, fiilka ugu weyn oo dambe ayaa la isticmaalaa infinitive (misaal 'quiero comer', 'evito hablar'). Laakiin, Ingiriisi, qaarkood ka mid ah fiilashu (sidoo kale 'enjoy', 'avoid', 'finish') baa u talinayaa gerund (-ing), oo kale oo fiilashu kalena (sidoo kale 'want', 'decide', 'hope') baa u talinayaa infinitive 'to'. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa jira fiilashii uu beddeli maanaheeda ee aad isticmaashid infinitive ama gerund (misaal, 'stop to smoke' vs. 'stop smoking'). Tafaafiskaan wuxuu u dhaqmaa inaad Ingiriisi ku hadashid mid dhabta ah.
rule: Ingiriisi, fiilashu ugu weyn ayaa la qaybiyey fiil kale oo labo sida: la 'to' oo ku hor jeeda infinitive (I want to go) ama gerund (-ing) (I enjoy going). Doorteeda waxay ku taallan taas oo fiilka ugu weyn. Liiska xumaysan: - Fiilashii uu qaataa infinitive: want, need, decide, hope, plan, promise, agree, offer, forget, learn, iyo kalena. - Fiilashii uu qaataa gerund: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, consider, suggest, practice, admit, deny, iyo kalena. - Fiilashii ay qaadan karaan labada qaab oo aan beddelin maanaheeda: start, begin, continue, like, love, hate, prefer. - Fiilashii uu beddeli maanaheeda: remember, forget, stop, try, regret. (Misaal 'Remember to lock the door' = xusuuso inaad luqad u dhigto; 'Remember locking the door' = xusuuntaa luqad u dhigtay). Fiir: fiilashii arkiyeyaasha iyo 'make' iyo 'let', waxaan isticmaalnaa infinitive oo aan 'to' (I saw him leave, They made me wait). Diida, 'not' ayaa la qoraa ilaa infinitive ama gerund (I decided not to go, I enjoy not working).

examples.original: They plan to travel next summer.

examples.note: 'Stop + infinitive' maanaheedu waa inaad joogtaa inaad samayso wax kalena.

examples.original: I stopped smoking last year.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ stɒpt ˈsməʊkɪŋ lɑːst jɪə/
examples.translation: Waxaan joogay inaan cabbi dhowo sanadkii ugu dambeeyey.
examples.note: 'Stop + gerund' maanaheedu waa inaad mar dambe samaynaysid shuqulkaas. Tafaasifku waa u dhaqmaa.

examples.original: Remember to call your mom tonight.

examples.note: 'Remember + infinitive' maanaheedu waa inaad xusuusato wajibaad u soo socda.

examples.original: I remember calling her yesterday.

examples.note: 'Remember + gerund' waxay la isticmaalaa inaad xusuusato wax ay soo noqotay. Farriisii waxay nuqulnaa 'recordar + haber + participio' ama 'recordar + que + verbo'.

title: Articles Advanced: Zero Article and Generic Use / Maqaalada Sare: Maqaalada Zero iyo Isticmaalka Generic
bridge: Faransiis, waxaan ka badan u isticmaamo maqaalada xaalada si aan u hadalno waxyaabaha oo umuma (sida 'los perros son fieles'). Ingiriisi, maqaalada ma isticmaalin: 'Dogs are loyal'. Tani waa khalad aan u dhaqan qaadanayay: waxaad dhahaysaa 'The dogs are loyal' Ingiriisi, waxaana la yiraahdaa inaad hadashay qofka kooban oo ay leedahay. Ingiriisi, maqaalada ma isticmaalin magacyada cuntada oo umuma ('I like rice'), halqad Faransiis ayaa isticmaalaya ('Me gusta el arroz').
rule: Ingiriisi, saddex dhammaan oo 'maqaalada zero' ku jira: 1) Si ay u hadalno waxyaalaha oo umuma la jira magacyada badan ama aan la tirin karin (sida 'Cats are cute', 'Water is essential'). 2) Magacyada cuntada, luuqadaha, riixyada iyo fasalka akhbaariga marka aan ay xaalad u ahyn (sida 'I speak English', 'She plays tennis'). 3) Talooyinka sida 'school', 'hospital', 'church', 'prison' marka aan u hadalno maqashiiyaashaas oo kaliya (sida 'He goes to school' - sida macalin, aan u ahyn sida qiiqaab). Khilaaf: magacyada singular oo la tirin kara, maqaal ama xaalad baa loo baahan yahay, haddii loo eego xaaladka umuma (sida 'A dog is man's best friend' ama 'The dog is a loyal animal'). 'Dog is loyal' ma larin karo in la hadlo kulli dogs. Haddana, Ingiriisi ma isticmaalin 'the' magacyada dalka aan jirto qaybaha siyaasada (sida 'Italy', 'Spain'), laakiin magacyada 'republic', 'kingdom' ama 'states' (sida 'the United States').

common_error.explanation: Faransiis, waxaan dhahay 'la vida es bella' la maqaalada xaalada maxaa yeelay waxaan hadalno nolosha oo umuma. Ingiriisi, marka la hadlo miyirka abstract oo umuma (nolosha, jeceshaha, farxadda), maqaalada zero ayaa la isticmaalaa. 'The life' waxay u fududayso nolosha oo xaalad u ah, sida 'the life of a star'. Xaqiiqta: magacyada aan la tirin Karin ama abstract, 'the' ma isticmaalin haddii aan jirin xaalad oo xaalad u ah.

levels.label: Zero Article with Plural and Uncountable Nouns
levels.translation: Maqaalada zero la magacyada badan iyo aan la tirin Karin

examples.original: Dogs are loyal friends.
examples.phonetic: /dɒgz ɑːr ˈlɔɪəl frendz/
examples.translation: Qaybaha ay yihiin saaxiibbad leedahay.
examples.note: Halkan 'Dogs' waxay u fududaystaan qaybaha oo umuma, sidaas daraaddeed maqaal ma hayo. Faransiis, waxaan isticmaan 'los'.

examples.original: Happiness comes from within.
examples.phonetic: /ˈhæpinəs kʌmz frɒm wɪˈðɪn/
examples.translation: Farxadda ayay ka yimaado dhexdooda.
examples.note: Magacyada abstract sida 'happiness' maqaal ma hayo marka ay noqon yihiin umuma.

examples.original: Water is necessary for survival.
examples.phonetic: /ˈwɔːtər ɪz ˈnesəsəri fɔːr sərˈvaɪvəl/
examples.translation: Biyaha ayay u baahan yihiin si ay u nolaataan.
examples.note: Magacyada aan la tirin Karin sida 'water' maqaal 'the' ma hayo haddii loo eego umuma.

levels.label: Zero Article with Meals, Languages, Sports, and Subjects
levels.translation: Maqaalada zero la cuntada, luuqadaha, riixyada iyo fasalka

examples.original: I have breakfast at seven.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ˈbrekfəst æt ˈsevən/
examples.translation: Anigu waan ka baxayaa subaxda.
examples.note: Ingiriisi, 'a breakfast' ama 'the breakfast' ma larin karo in la hadlo cuntada oo umuma. Faransiis, waxaan ka badan u isticmaan maqaal: 'el desayuno'.

examples.original: They speak Spanish in Peru.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ spiːk ˈspænɪʃ ɪn pəˈruː/
examples.translation: Waxay hadlaan Faransiis Peru.
examples.note: Luuqadaha maqaal ma hayo Ingiriisi, isku khilaaf Faransiis oo aan dhahno 'el español'.

examples.original: Football is popular in Europe.
examples.phonetic: /ˈfʊtbɔːl ɪz ˈpɒpjʊlər ɪn ˈjʊərəp/
examples.translation: Kaalka ayay ku caansan yihiin Europe.
examples.note: Riixyada maqaal ma hayo. Faransiis, waxaan dhahay 'el fútbol'.

levels.label: Zero Article with Institutions and Fixed Phrases
levels.translation: Maqaalada zero la talooyinka iyo erayada oo xad gudbeen

examples.original: He goes to school by bus.
examples.phonetic: /hiː ɡəʊz tə skuːl baɪ bʌs/
examples.translation: Wuxuu u tagaa school bus.
examples.note: Maqaal ma hayo marka la isticmaalo 'school' si ay u hadalno maqashiiyaasha. Haddii ay u tagaan in ay soo booqato, waxay noqonaysaa 'to the school'.

examples.original: She is in hospital after the accident.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪz ɪn ˈhɒspɪtl ˈɑːftə ði ˈæksɪdənt/
examples.translation: Ayay ku jirtaa hospital dhibaatooyinka.
examples.note: Ingiriishi, 'in hospital' waxay u fududaystaan in la dhex galay. Ingiriisi, waxay dhahay 'in the hospital' oo kalena qofka aan la dhex galin.

examples.original: They go to church every Sunday.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɡəʊ tə tʃɜːtʃ ˈevri ˈsʌndeɪ/
examples.translation: Waxay u tataan church maalmihii axad.
examples.note: Si ay u soo booqato adeegga sharciga, maqaal ma isticmaalin. Haddii aad u tagaan inaad soo booqato binu-malayska, waxay noqonaysaa 'to the church'.

examples.original: We went to bed early.
examples.phonetic: /wiː went tə bed ˈɜːli/
examples.translation: Waxaan ku noqonayay dhinac early.
examples.note: Erayada oo xad gudbeen sida 'go to bed', 'go to work', 'at home' maqaal ma hayo.

translations.so: Maqaalada sare: maqaalada zero iyo isticmaalka generic
